title: #293 wire: which seam runs mutation, and what proves the suite is green
context: Option A step 3. The per-turn hook-completion Stop seam must never run mutation (acceptance 5). paqad installs no git hook or CI, so ci-backstop and git-backstop fire only when a project calls runtime/scripts/verify-backstop.mjs from its own CI or pre-push hook: mutation is opt-in by design. runMutationGate skips with tests-not-green unless testsGreen is true, and nothing in the backstop sets structured_test_results today. The feature bundle (and its checks.json) is git-ignored, so it does not exist on CI.

options.label: Run on ci-backstop and git-backstop; the green signal is the project's own test command (project profile 'test') run first in the mutation step; red reads 'did not run (tests not green)'
